programs.title: The Daughter I Gave Away
programs.desc: Fifteen years after a teenage girl places her baby up for adoption, she learns that her daughter has gone missing from the adoptive parent's home. In her search for answers, she uncovers a chilling truth.

programs.title: The Mother Flip
programs.desc: Rebecca and Kristy take on a recently raided, abandoned house, now up for sale at a very low price. A real hot mess, this eyesore is currently a raccoon den with a sagging roof and holes in the walls.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael brings a taste of Mexico to Lake George with her twist on chile relleno stuffed poblano peppers. Her version is filled with tortilla chips, cheese, pinto bean dip and more cheese.

programs.title: Jake Makes It Easy
programs.sub_title: Soupless Chicken Soup & Carrot Sweet Potato Cake
programs.desc: This roast chicken and vegetable dish is truly two classics in one: amazing roast chicken with all the flavours of a soul-warming chicken soup, without the soup.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael makes a decadent Tuscan-style breakfast for dinner using panettone bread to make French toast, which she serves with a prosciutto and melon platter.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Taiwanese cuisine boasts wide variations of chicken soup, and Chef A-lin has a special recipe. Learn more about how Chef A-lin creates the most complex flavor with the most elegant approach.
